_comment: T1.3 (spec 674) ratchet for prose-tier cross-skill references. Blocking-tier refs are never baselined - they fail outright. This number may only go DOWN; raising it requires a deliberate commit that says why.
_history: 90 -> 122 on 2026-07-30 when the prose tier was widened from code-spans-only to every markup form a skill body actually uses (bold, italic, links, angle brackets), and fenced-code hits were demoted into this tier rather than discarded. Not a regression: the same references were always there, the earlier detector could not see them.
_blocking_note: TEMPORARY, and the only reason it is not 0: wiring this gate into CI while 35 pre-existing blocking references sat in the tree turned every PR red for a condition the PR did not cause. T1.1 is the remediation - rewrite each site to {{skill:<name>}} - and this number must fall to 0 when it lands. Any INCREASE fails the build today. Do not raise it.
_sites_note: Pins WHICH references are tolerated, not just how many. A count-only ratchet cannot see a SWAP - remove one blocking reference, add a different one, total unchanged, brand new silent-failure site admitted. Any site not on this list fails. Removing a site is always allowed; lower blocking_total with it.
